QuestInfo.name: Chief Dawn Warrior
QuestInfo.0: It's time for your 4th Job Advancement test. Talk to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart wonders what you think about the idea of becoming a Chief Knight and leading Dawn Warriors. Sounds like a lot of work! You told him you'd think about it.
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart wonders what you think about the idea of becoming a Chief Knight and leading Dawn Warriors. Sounds like a lot of work! You told him you'd think about it.

0.0: Mihile, the others seem to trust you. There is even among the younger knights about who can be as good as you have supposedly become. As you know, I am not one to waste a resource... \r\n#L0##bWhat do you want me to do now, Neinheart?#l\n#k
0.1: The knights' numbers have grown too swiftly. Managing them into meaningful action has become nigh impossible. I plan on dividing them into five distinct groups based on their specialties, and I want you to lead one. Will you take on the responsibility of heading the Dawn Warriors? \r\n#L0##bCan't you get somebody else to do it?#l\n#k
0.2: I'm not the sort of man to accept substitutes. Cygnus needs you to take on this position.\r\n#L0##bI don't know, this is pretty sudden. Can you at least give me a little time to think about it?#l\n#k
0.3: Fine. Take your time to bat the decision about in that dense skull of yours and then come back to me when you're ready to accept.

yes.0: I'll be here when you're ready to admit that I am correct.

no.0: Do not make any decisions you'll regret... like saying no to me.
